title: The Hospital That Incinerated Alive Patients—For Insurance
hook: When a hospital realized dead bodies paid more than living patients, they didn't wait for nature to take its course.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the primal fear of being killed by those trusted to save you with the outrage of profit-driven murder.

title: The Doctor Who Transplanted a Pig Heart—Into a Healthy Man
hook: The patient wasn't dying. The doctor just wanted to see what would happen. The man lived for 3 hours.
why_this_can_go_viral: The grotesque visual and ethical violation triggers immediate curiosity and outrage sharing.
